# White Stone PTE & Overseas Consultants

> Official overseas education consultancy, specialist Pearson PTE Academic computer training lab, IELTS coaching, and student visa processing center in Hafizabad, Punjab, Pakistan.

## About
White Stone PTE & Overseas Consultants is an educational consultancy located near Punjab College on Gujranwala Road in Hafizabad, Pakistan. We specialize in international student admissions and visa processing for 8 destination countries: the United Kingdom, Australia, Cyprus, Turkey, Sweden, Finland, China, and South Korea. We also host Hafizabad's premier Pearson PTE Academic testing and preparation computer lab, IELTS coaching classes, Spoken English courses, and Office Management diploma programs.

## Key Services
- [Study Visas](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html): Complete admissions guidance, SOP/CV drafting, university applications, embassy interview preparation, and student visa filing for UK, Australia, Cyprus, Turkey, Sweden, Finland, China, and South Korea.
- [PTE Academic Lab](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/services.html): Modern computer testing lab in Hafizabad equipped with noise-cancelling Pearson-certified headsets, real-time AI scoring software, mock tests, and personalized score booster sessions.
- [IELTS Coaching](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/services.html): Comprehensive Academic and General Training IELTS modules covering Reading, Writing, Listening, and Speaking with experienced instructors.
- [Spoken English & Office Management](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/services.html): Professional conversational English fluency training and certified computer applications/office management courses.

## Study Destinations
- [United Kingdom](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#uk): 1-Year Masters programs, 2-Year Graduate Route Post-Study Work (PSW) permits, Russell Group & modern universities.
- [Australia](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#australia): Subclass 500 student visas, 2-4 year Temporary Graduate (subclass 485) PSW, regional university PR pathway points.
- [Cyprus](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#cyprus): Affordable European education, English-medium programs, high visa success rates without complex financial requirements.
- [Turkey](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#turkey): YTB Government Scholarships, European Bologna-standard degrees, low tuition fees, and rich cultural heritage.
- [Sweden](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#sweden): World-class Scandinavian universities, English-taught Master's degrees, and family visa benefits.
- [Finland](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#finland): Type-A Residence Permit counting 100% towards 4-Year Finnish PR, 30 hours/week work rights, generous tuition waivers.
- [China](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#china): Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC), Silk Road scholarships, 100% free tuition and living stipends, English-medium MBBS programs.
- [South Korea](https://whitestoneconsultants.online/countries.html#korea): Global Korea Scholarship (GKS), generous university merit discounts, cutting-edge technology and engineering hub.
